claim.value: An insensitive outcome can produce no detectable effect even when the mechanism being addressed matters.
claim.scope: A possible measurement limitation, not a finding that the selected outcome is insensitive.

provenance.rationale: P034 explicitly states this possibility without asserting that outcome insensitivity actually occurred.

signal_basis.value: The release test measures differences in first-publication rates and their uncertainty; an insensitive outcome may yield no detectable effect.
signal_basis.scope: A possible null measurement result in the described release test, without establishing the underlying mechanism's importance or the outcome's actual sensitivity.

provenance.rationale: P022 supplies the measured signal and its uncertainty; P034 supplies the possible failure to detect an effect through outcome insensitivity.
This supported possibility claim requires no unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: An outcome that does not respond sensitively to relevant changes can fail to register an effect despite an important underlying mechanism. The claim states only this measurement possibility; it does not infer that insensitivity explains any observed null result.
uncertainty: Whether the selected outcome is actually insensitive remains unknown and is outside the claim.
